GoEmotions (first file): 5313 examples; 2125 train naive-Bayes, 3188 evaluated (1165 short <=10 words, 2023 long). 500 audit draws per cell, seed 20261022.
estimand: human prevalence short - long over the evaluated items = 0.2112 - 0.2640 = -0.0528
rules: ppi = always correct; overall = qual-gate's z test on all audited items; gap = z test on the gap bias (mean(human-coder) in short minus long); tostD = naive only if the gap bias's 90% interval is inside +-D. Else the group-wise prediction-powered gap.
